name: Shiva septum ('pleasure center') signal
origin: Shiva software by Todd Murphy (signal templates licensed from Persinger and Koren)
summary: Murphy's simple Shiva septum session: his 'pleasure center' signal stepped counter-clockwise around the head, played here with this project's own waveform. The vendor page describes the septum (pleasant and sexual sensations are what the structure 'has been associated with'), not effects of the session; the Shakti version 'has been tested with only a few human and no animal subjects'.
setting: Dark, quiet room, eyes closed, relaxed without meditating or falling asleep.
schedule: At most once a week, never on consecutive days; up to 6 sessions, then a 21-day break.
notes: The Shiva page describes the septum, not the session: 'It has been associated with different kinds of pleasant sensations, mainly those related to sexual experiences' (septum_page.htm). The only description of the waveform is that the signal has 'very low frequencies' and so 'requires a higher volume than the others'. The vendor rates it untested: 'It has been tested with only a few human and no animal subjects. If you are not comfortable using untested signals, do not use this one' (Shakti septum_consent.htm). The waveform here is this project's own design, not the Shiva file: a rising sweep from 1 to 6 Hz, 230 points of 3 ms (0.69 s), then 4 s of silence. This file runs 20 min. Coils sit on the vendor's Shiva ring (Fp1, FT7, TP7, O1, O2, TP8, FT8, Fp2) and fire one at a time, counter-clockwise seen from above. Shiva has a coil pair at each position; one coil keeps the timing and covers about half the arc. The step of 10, 12 ... 20 ms per coil is this project's reading of a lecture example with no unit named (Murphy lecture 19:42-19:53); this session's step table is not published. The vendor gives no number for Shiva's field. This program's setting is the peak field 20 mm in front of each coil. At 1 uT that is about 24 uT at the scalp. Nothing supports an effect of this file. The vendor's Shakti pages say the signal is 'not a treatment' for sexual problems. Independent sham-controlled tests of God-Helmet-type fields found no field effect (Granqvist 2005, double-blind; Gendle & McGrath 2012, where the experimenter knew the condition). Stop if it is unpleasant; not for people with epilepsy.
source: Murphy, Shiva demo: Septum signal https://www.god-helmet.com/wp/shiva/shiva_demo/septum_page.htm ; Murphy, Shakti demo: Septum signal https://www.god-helmet.com/wp/winshakti/demo/shakti_demo/septum_consent.htm ; Murphy, Shakti and the brain's pleasure center – the septum https://www.god-helmet.com/wp/pleasure_center.htm ; Murphy, Shakti demo: What are 'Rapid' and 'High-Speed' signals? https://www.god-helmet.com/wp/winshakti/demo/shakti_demo/rapid_&_high_speed_signals.htm ; Murphy, Shiva demo: Magnetic coil locations https://www.god-helmet.com/wp/shiva/shiva_demo/locations.htm ; Murphy, Psychic Skills & Miracles lecture (coil steps of 10, 12 ... 20 ms) https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tmC1174POpA ; Murphy, Shiva demo: Session lengths https://www.god-helmet.com/wp/shiva/shiva_demo/session_length.htm ; Granqvist et al. 2005, Neurosci Lett 379:1 https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/15849873/ ; Gendle & McGrath 2012, Percept Mot Skills 114:217 https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/22582690/
